features.name: Champion Challenge / Turn the Tide
features.desc: With Channel Divinity, you challenge the enemies around you (they can't move away from you) or turn the tide of battle by healing your allies.

features.name: Divine Allegiance
features.desc: As a Reaction when a creature within 5 feet takes damage, you take that damage instead (your Resistances and Immunities don't reduce it).

features.name: Unyielding Spirit
features.desc: You have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Paralyzed and Stunned conditions.

features.name: Exalted Champion
features.desc: As an action, for 1 hour: Resistance to nonmagical weapon damage; allies within 30 feet have Advantage on Wisdom saving throws and Death Saving Throws. When you drop to 0 Hit Points, you rise with 1 Hit Point (once per hour).
